_comment: CLAIM stokes_darcy::3: [Numerical] The Brinkman/Stokes system is a saddle point, so the velocity and pressure spaces must satisfy the LBB (inf-sup) condition; the Darcy drag term does not rescue an unstable pair. Wrong variant: equal-order P1/P1 velocity/pressure (and, differently wrong, P1 velocity with DG0 pressure). Right variant: Taylor-Hood P2/P1 (or P3/P2). Single-mesh Brinkman on the unit square: porous lower half with K = 1e-4, free upper half, no-slip on the two horizontal walls, unit pressure imposed weakly at the inlet x = 0 and zero at the outlet x = 1, MUMPS LU. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars); every expect_in_output string above is text the software actually printed.
